name: Paymo
summary: Paymo combines task management with time tracking and invoicing. Its free plan covers 1 user and 2 projects. Plus lists at $10.90 and Pro at $16.90 per user a month on monthly billing for new accounts, rising to $15.90 and $23.90 after three months.

facts.text: The free plan covers 1 user, 1 client, 2 projects and 1 GB of storage, with unlimited tasks, time entries and invoices.
Task List view is on every plan, Kanban from Solo, the Meta Kanban board and table view from Plus, and the Gantt chart on Pro only.
The intro prices are up to 40% off for the first three months for accounts created after September 25, 2026, and cannot be combined with other offers.
The trial lasts 15 days with full access to the chosen plan and no credit card.

plans.name: Solo
plans.notes: 1 user. $5.90 for the first three months

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Monthly billing. $10.90 for the first three months

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Monthly billing. $16.90 for the first three months. Adds the Gantt chart

hiddenCosts: The headline prices are intro prices for the first three months, and the ongoing monthly price is higher.
The Gantt chart needs the Pro plan.
Annual per-user prices are not stated in the page text, which says annual billing saves up to 40%.
